principle: A pretrained branch is accepted only against the same architecture with random initialization and the established scientific baseline under an unchanged split.

fault.research_question: Can volumetric pretraining improve sparse fault detection without turning unlabelled voxels into negatives?
fault.scientific_baseline: local multiscale discontinuity features plus logistic probability head
fault.split_contract: grouped spatial validation with interpreted-positive and explicitly sampled negative policy unchanged
fault.promotion_rule: promote only if the pretrained condition improves grouped validation and the gate is non-degrading
fault.current_evidence: data gate blocked; no foundation-model gain claim

facies.research_question: Does Hiera pretraining transfer reflection texture and boundary context across F3 and Penobscot domains?
facies.scientific_baseline: FPN-ResNet18 on F3 and DeepLabV3+-ResNet18 on Penobscot
controlled_conditions: same Hiera fusion path with random initialization
facies.split_contract: spatially separated folds and unchanged cross-survey evaluation
facies.promotion_rule: pretraining must outperform random initialization, not merely the smaller CNN
facies.current_evidence: development gain observed; pretraining attribution pending because random-init control is incomplete

property.research_question: Can in-context tabular pretraining improve sparse-well regression while preserving physical target routing?
property.scientific_baseline: ExtraTrees for PHIF/KLOGH and XGBoost for SW
controlled_conditions: TabICL on the identical prepared feature table
property.split_contract: mother-well grouped folds with train-fold-only transforms
property.promotion_rule: TabICL remains a comparator unless it improves grouped validation and physical diagnostics
property.current_evidence: tree baseline confirmed; TabICL not promoted

lithofacies.research_question: Does time-series pretraining improve fixed-nine genetic-facies discrimination beyond a strong windowed tree baseline?
lithofacies.scientific_baseline: XGBoost multi-softprob on aligned well-log windows
lithofacies.split_contract: LOGO4 mother-well folds with fixed-nine labels and unchanged class weighting
lithofacies.promotion_rule: pretrained MOMENT must improve both random initialization and XGBoost under fixed-nine metrics
lithofacies.current_evidence: pretraining effect small and non-beneficial; no fusion with the operational XGBoost output

sweetspot.research_question: Can time-series pretraining improve causal production forecasting without collapsing heterogeneous geological targets into one score?
sweetspot.scientific_baseline: target-routed GBDT models; historical-mean and XGBoost comparators for T3
sweetspot.split_contract: strict chronological cutoffs; static targets retain independent well-grouped splits
sweetspot.promotion_rule: Chronos-2 contributes only to T3 and only after temporal-holdout improvement
sweetspot.current_evidence: development gain recorded; frozen temporal-holdout diagnostic remains weak

reconstruction.research_question: Can pretrained volumetric context recover spatial structure missed by kriging without degrading a reliable geostatistical baseline?
controlled_conditions: same residual encoder with random initialization
reconstruction.split_contract: strict and conditional spatial holdouts reported separately
reconstruction.promotion_rule: the residual branch must improve pointwise metrics and spatial structure; otherwise the gate returns to OK3D
reconstruction.current_evidence: development diagnostic only; current conditional reconstruction is strongly over-smoothed
